description: Install a prebuilt Institution Kit — a complete governed org chart template with sealed charters ready to convene. Three kits available: "engineering-suite" (ARB + RAB for tech teams), "federal-ai-board" (ARMB + AEOB, NIST/CMMC/FedRAMP/EO14110 aligned), "eu-ai-risk-council" (HRAAB + CAB, EU AI Act + GDPR aligned). Each kit creates an institution with multiple charters, all pre-sealed and ready to use.
name: board_install_kit
